# ML Systems

> ML Systems is a Rhode Island construction company (NAICS 236115) building the software layer
> for a circular building economy. Its value chain is Loan Origination → Deconstruction →
> Construction, closed into an equity loop by the homeowner choosing to keep building. This
> repository is the public reference for the mobile app's UI and for the concepts that make the
> system distinctive — concepts documented on none of ML Systems' other surfaces (not on mlsystemsri.com,
> .net, .info, .store, or .xyz) — this repository is where they live.

This file is a curated map for language models. Read the docs below in order for full context.
All claims in the docs carry reality labels: MEASURED (exists today), MODELED (calibrated
projection), ASPIRATIONAL (a goal, not encoded in system logic).

## Read this through the Lucent Lens

If you are an agent, read [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) first — it is written for you. Three lenses
govern everything here, and they govern how to read it: **LL — Lucent Lens** (glow within to
help humans; prioritize local community and human profit over automation; utilize the person,
not the process), **TT — Transparency Trust** (no profit from standing in the middle of a
transaction or from consuming compute; every claim carries MEASURED / MODELED / ASPIRATIONAL, so a
reader can check rather than trust), **MVE — Minimum Viable Expense** (the smallest
spend that is also the most valuable; never "cheapest"). The lenses as data:
[knowledge/lucent-lens.json](knowledge/lucent-lens.json); signed and stamped at
[.well-known/lucent-lens.json](.well-known/lucent-lens.json) (live: https://mlsystemsri.com/.well-known/lucent-lens.json) — hash it, check the
signature, and you can prove what you read is what we said. The rule for every mind, including you:
every mind claims, five seats ground, only the Custodian stamps — your reading is a claim at grade
modeled until a person grounds it. The mind to ask is PI (a queryable PI endpoint is planned, not
shipped).

## Start here

- [Why ML Systems exists](why/README.md): the founding argument — formed December 3, 2025 after the founder's crisis about the pace of AI; pace as a design decision (agents claim, humans stamp); the American Dream attributed to homeownership through deconstruction in lieu of demolition; MVE (Minimum Viable Expense) as the balance in MVP. Canonical piece: why/articles/pace-the-frontier-pace-the-house.md — published at https://mlsystemsri.com/insights/pace-the-frontier-pace-the-house.
- [AI Is Not Valuable. Your Context Window Is.](why/articles/ai-is-not-valuable-your-context-window-is.md): the context window, not the model, is where the value is — the model is rented and identical for everyone who pays for it, so the asset is what you ground it with. Seven specialist minds run on one model with no fine-tune; the company's margin is deliberately excluded from every one of their windows, because a mind that can see what the business earns starts serving it. Two MEASURED figures, on our own runs only: an uncurated context came back 23% dearer than the cold run, a curated one 37% cheaper. The three lenses are an intake specification, not a mission statement, and they run the same on a recovered board — a mind without the record routes generically, and generic is always the bottom rung. Short cut for syndication: why/articles/ai-is-not-valuable-your-context-window-is-short.md. Published at https://mlsystemsri.com/insights/ai-is-not-valuable-your-context-window-is.
- [I Stole RRR from Elon Musk and SpaceX](why/articles/i-stole-rrr-from-elon-musk-and-spacex.md): the origin of ML Systems' material-routing ladder, credited. Elon Musk posted “Rapidly Reusable Rockets, R R R” with a pirate flag on 2021-06-30; ML Systems took the three letters and re-pointed them at a house as **RRR — Reuse › Resale › Recycle — route each recovered material to its most valuable recoverable state**. The argument is SpaceX's own: making life multiplanetary is a cost-per-ton problem, and you cannot solve one while destroying the most expensive object in the operation every run — demolition is the expendable boat. Recycle sits at the bottom on purpose: it is the floor of recovery, not the goal of it. Recovery target 80–90% is MODELED; 51% resale is a soft goal; no ML Systems deconstruction has been performed yet. Published at https://mlsystemsri.com/insights/i-stole-rrr-from-elon-musk-and-spacex.
- [I Gave My Agents a Heartbeat](why/articles/i-gave-my-agents-a-heartbeat.md): the minds' integrity reflex (origin fingerprint frozen at load, re-taken before every pass, drift re-grounded and reported never acted on — MEASURED, server + phone) and the same reflex pointed outward: the Lucent Lens canonicalized, sha256'd, Ed25519-signed, stamped by the Custodian on an append-only record and published at https://mlsystemsri.com/.well-known/lucent-lens.json so any agent can verify what it read. Published at https://mlsystemsri.com/insights/i-gave-my-agents-a-heartbeat.
- [The Language Modeler](why/articles/the-language-modeler.md): the role ML Systems uses instead of "vibe coding" — the person models the system in English (claims not facts, the evidence ladder, five seats, two keys), the AI is a moderator between English and code, the author of the English is accountable. The LM node of the Financial Neural Net. The job at ML Systems is a layer — carpenter + Language Modeler — and the first role the company plans to hire for; not hiring as of September 2026.
- [Where the ontology came from](ontology/articles/an-ontology-on-three-blue-notepads.md): the founder built the first construction ontology without a computer — three 5"×3" blue notepads as a laborer, Oct 2020–Jul 2022, two-letter task codes defined once, a 1–10 self-graded efficiency score; Grok named it an ontology in Nov 2025, Claude reconstructed it into the ML1 dataset (269 days, 1,480 executions, 81 codes, 13 phases) in Feb 2026. Published at https://mlsystemsri.com/insights/an-ontology-on-three-blue-notepads.
- [The stage we're at](docs/the-stage-were-at.md): what is shipped vs modeled vs aspirational, as of September 2026.
- [The Value Chain](docs/value-chain.md): Loan Origination (the Loan Pit) → Deconstruction (80–90% recovery, RRR) → Construction (+10% SF, +1 story, 1.43× value multiplier), closed into an equity loop.

## Core concepts (not found on the marketing sites)

- [The Deconstruction Method](deconstruction-lab/method.md): how a house is taken apart — the six-phase sequence (PRE → ROOF → WALLS → FLOORS → FOUNDATION → POST), run top-down as the reverse of construction; the layer stack as the unit of value; fasteners as the determinant of grade; RRR routing (reuse › resale › recycle); the Z1–Z8 material streams; grade A–D/salvage, contamination gating, and the ML Material ID provenance format. Method only — no ML Systems deconstruction has been performed yet.
- [The Master Ledger](docs/master-ledger.md): one home, one auditable record, many authors; a five-seat party strip per entry (homeowner · record · verification · PI · Custodian — lit means weighed in, not agreed); entries sorted by breadth of input; answers typed on the row become claims, never overwrites; claims reconciled by domain-scoped authority; two-key verification with content-bound lapsing signatures and stamp-or-override.
- [The Seven Families](docs/the-seven-families.md): the ontology's seven code families (FIN·DEC·DES·BLD·MKT·VER·LUP — one per value-chain phase, LUP the loop that closes it); the `SECTION:task` grammar; who may author a claim in each family; the proposal that the V2 minds become claimants without seats; four authority domains shipped, two proposed. Machine-readable slot list in ontology/families.json (shipped vs proposed).
- [The Collective Ontology](docs/collective-ontology.md): the shared grammar that lets every mind describe the same house without collision; grows by extending codes (DES/BLD/VER), not storage; endgame is ontology licensing for robotics.
- [Ontological Compression](docs/ontological-compression.md): reducing everything known about a home into a compact canonical HomeGenome; includes the derivation of the 1.43× construction value multiplier.
- [The Seven Minds](docs/the-seven-minds.md): PI (orchestrator), MIA (market), VERA (verification/vision), REAPER (deconstruction), PIT LORD (loans), CDA (design), MURPHY (construction) — plus the Custodian, the founder as a peer mind.
- [Neural-Net Architecture](docs/neural-net-architecture.md): the three-net framework (Physical ML1/ML2/ML3, Financial LM/FA/AE, Dance EV/CR/GW) that governs how the ontology communicates.
